blocks.markdown: The **genitive** case marks possession — Croatian has no word for "of" or an apostrophe-s; the noun itself changes instead. Feminine **-a** becomes **-e**: *kuća* → **vrata kuće** (the door of the house). Masculine nouns add **-a**: *grad* → **centar grada** (the center of the city).

The genitive is also used after most negated verbs, instead of the accusative: **Nemam kruha** (I don't have [any] bread) — *kruh* shifts from its plain form to the genitive **kruha** once the sentence is negated.

exercises.prompt: vrata ___. (kuća → genitive: kuće — the door of the house)
centar ___. (grad → genitive — the center of the city)
Translate: "I don't have bread." (negation triggers the genitive: kruha)
